description: Open-source TTS project from Hugging Face. Parler-TTS generates speech whose speaker style (gender, pitch, speaking rate, recording quality) is controlled by a natural-language text description; the Mini (880M) and Large (2.3B) v1 checkpoints were trained on 45k hours of audiobook data and released under Apache-2.0 with their datasets and training code.
name: Parler-TTS (Hugging Face)
